subject: Re: Demo — security, infra & procurement added; need to reschedule
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <schen@cybercore.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <talvarez@bronzehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: intro + live runthrough (confirming 60m)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I penciled in a 60-minute demo for Wed 10/11 at 11:00 AM PT so your team can see the Redwood inference flow and ask questions.

Quick notes:
- We'll cover hosted vs dedicated deployment and the runtime failover story (20m).
- Live token-cost walk and console tour (20m).
- Q&A with a focus on procurement/SLAs (20m).

If more stakeholders need to join (security or infra), happy to extend to 90–120 minutes — just tell me who and what their priorities are so we can adjust the agenda.

I attached a one-page checklist of artifacts we typically surface for SOC2 and procurement — feel free to share.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: CyberCore-Security-Risk-Worksheet.xlsx
From: Sarah Chen <schen@cybercore.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: CyberCore Procurement <procurement@cybercore.com>, Tom Alvarez <talvarez@bronzehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: intro + live runthrough (confirming 60m)

Thanks Alex — appreciate the checklist. Quick update: procurement and our security lead need to be present.

- Ivana (security) will join and wants a deeper look at audit logs, key management, and data retention controls.
- Procurement will want contract-level SLAs and standard T&Cs reviewed.

Also, two heads-up items: our CISO has a travel conflict the week of 10/11, and procurement prefers a 90–120 minute slot to avoid follow-ups. Can you propose alternate windows later that week or the next?

Tom — looping you in in case procurement wants to add anything.

Cheers,
Sarah
Head of Product Security | CyberCore Health
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: CyberCore Procurement <procurement@cybercore.com>, Sarah Chen <schen@cybercore.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: intro + live runthrough (confirming 60m)

Understood — thanks for the heads up, Sarah.

Priya and Marissa from our team can cover security artifacts and procurement terms respectively. Priya, Marissa — can you join this thread and flag any pre-reads that would be helpful? We should probably move to a 120-minute block to accommodate a security ramp and contract discussion.

Proposed alternate windows (all PT):
- Tue 10/17, 9:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed 10/18, 1:00–3:00 PM PT
- Thu 10/19, 8:30–10:30 AM PT

If those don't work, tell me the best days/times and we'll try to align.

Alex

Subject: Re: Demo: intro + live runthrough (confirming 60m)

Hi all —

I'll take the security portion. Helpful if CyberCore can share the top 3 questions Ivana wants covered (audit retention length, KMS integration, and customer data segmentation are common). That lets me prep the demo traces and bring the right console tabs.

On time: the windows Alex proposed look fine from our side but Karthik on infra is traveling next week — Karthik, any hard blocks?

Also attaching a short list of docs we typically hand to security during the call so you can pass to Ivana.

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Security Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CYBERCORE-PROC-QA.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, CyberCore Procurement <procurement@cybercore.com>, Sarah Chen <schen@cybercore.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: intro + live runthrough (confirming 60m)

Morning team —

I/O infra overlap here: I'll be on customer site travel the mornings of 10/17 and 10/18 and only available after 2:00 PM PT on those days. If we need me for architecture/Q&A, the earliest feasible window from infra is Thu 10/19 8:30–10:30 AM PT (but note that's early for me on the east coast).

Two suggestions to unblock scheduling quickly:
1) Keep the 120-minute session on Thu 10/19 8:30–10:30 AM PT and I'll join remotely (I can handle infra questions).
2) Or split into two shorter sessions: security + product run (90m) the week of 10/17 with procurement-only follow-up the week after.

Either works; we should pick based on CyberCore's preference for seeing the end-to-end flow in one shot vs splitting.

Karthik
VP, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: CyberCore Procurement <procurement@cybercore.com>, Sarah Chen <schen@cybercore.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Thu 10/19, 8:30–10:30 AM PT — extended runthrough + procurement Q&A

Thanks everyone — appreciate the flexibility. Final plan:

- Date/time: Thu, Oct 19, 8:30–10:30 AM PT (120 minutes).
- Who: Sarah (security), Ivana (security lead), CyberCore procurement, Tom (observer), plus our team: Priya (security), Marissa (procurement/contract), Karthik (infra), and me.
- Agenda: 1) runtime architecture & failover (30m), 2) live demo + token-cost walk (30m), 3) security artifacts deep dive (30m), 4) procurement/contract Q&A (30m).
- Pre-reads: CyberCore please share Ivana's top-3 security questions. We shared a short doc and the procurement QA ahead of the session.

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm Ivana's attendance and send top-3 priorities (ASAP).
- Procurement: share any specific contract clauses to review in advance.
- Priya & Karthik: prepare the KMS and KV-cache diagrams for the security segment.
- Marissa: prepare a short summary of our standard SLA/credits language and a sample contract redline.

If anything changes (Ivana's travel or your procurement lead's availability), say the word and we'll split into two sessions.

Looking forward to it — calendar invites going now.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
